mapper.select: SELECT id, main_title AS mainTitle, summary, topic_status AS topicStatus, confidence_score AS confidenceScore, platform_count AS platformCount, hotspot_count AS hotspotCount, related_platforms AS relatedPlatforms, first_seen_time AS firstSeenTime, last_seen_time AS lastSeenTime, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM cross_platform_topic WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT th.topic_id AS topicId, th.hotspot_id AS hotspotId, th.platform, th.title, th.match_score AS matchScore, th.is_primary AS `primary`, h.rank_num AS rankNum, h.hot_value AS hotValue, h.source_url AS sourceUrl, h.crawl_time AS crawlTime FROM cross_platform_topic_hotspot th LEFT JOIN hotspot h ON th.hotspot_id = h.id WHERE th.topic_id = #{topicId} ORDER BY th.is_primary DESC, FIELD(th.platform, 'weibo', 'douyin', 'bilibili'), th.id ASC
